sanity_rule: First auto/vlp/seed42 run is prespecified primary; independent repeat excluded. Never select between repeats by score. Full matrix gated by evaluator identity and training sanity report.
primary_endpoint: CLOSED exact accuracy 1546 QA, 612 image clusters

bootstrap.algorithm: resample 5 seeds, then independently resample 612 images within each sampled seed slot; identical image and seed draws across paired configs and regimes

checkpoint_selection: validation overall_acc, strictly better selects new best; ties keep earliest epoch
failure_rules: unexpected ROI processing error or absent/corrupt mask file
rerun_policy: No score-based restart. Technical failures quarantined and recorded; rerun same seed/recipe only. Pipeline stops for diagnosis.
historical: supplementary only; never included in primary seed summaries
roi: All cohort masks generated once in locked environment and immutable audited bank; same bank used by every seed, empty post-filter result is valid, processing exception is invalid. None bypasses use of masks, but audit still verifies regime bank.
precision: float32, no AMP, MPS, fixed CPU fallback
initialization: Every new run independently starts optimizer from same stage2 state; not resume existing stage3
evaluator: fixed batch size4, original manifest order, greedy generation, no sampling, float32, deterministic algorithms strict
lens_rng_fix: random.Random() replaced with global seeded random; separate seeded DataLoader generator
optional_interventions: Deferred until primary matrix and analysis complete; not part of primary stopping rule
